name: Xia Dynasty
description: The Xia Dynasty is traditionally considered China's first dynasty, though its historical existence is debated. It marks the transition from tribal society to state organization.
chineseDescription: 夏朝被认为是中国第一个朝代，虽然其历史存在仍有争议。它标志着从部落社会向国家组织的过渡。
achievements: Created irrigation and flood control systems

notableEmperors.name: Yu the Great
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Founded Xia Dynasty, famous for flood control, established hereditary rule

notableEmperors.name: Qi
notableEmperors.accomplishments: First hereditary ruler, consolidated dynastic power

notableEmperors.name: Jie
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Last Xia ruler, known for tyranny, overthrown by Shang

name: Shang Dynasty
description: The Shang Dynasty is the first Chinese dynasty with archaeological evidence. It's known for advanced bronze work, oracle bone script, and sophisticated social structure.
chineseDescription: 商朝是第一个有考古证据的中国朝代。以先进的青铜器、甲骨文和复杂的社会结构而闻名。
achievements: Developed oracle bone script (earliest Chinese writing)

notableEmperors.name: Tang of Shang
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Founded Shang Dynasty, overthrew Xia, established benevolent rule

notableEmperors.name: Pan Geng
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Moved capital to Yin, stabilized dynasty

notableEmperors.name: Wu Ding
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Longest reign, expanded territory, cultural flourishing

notableEmperors.name: Di Xin (King Zhou)
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Last Shang king, known for tyranny, overthrown by Zhou

name: Zhou Dynasty
description: The Zhou Dynasty was the longest-lasting Chinese dynasty. It introduced the Mandate of Heaven concept and saw the development of Confucianism and Taoism during the Spring and Autumn and Warring States periods.
chineseDescription: 周朝是中国历史上最长的朝代。引入了天命思想，春秋战国时期儒家和道家思想发展。
achievements: Flourishing of philosophy (Hundred Schools of Thought)

notableEmperors.name: King Wu
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Founded Zhou Dynasty, overthrew Shang, established feudal system

notableEmperors.name: King Cheng
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Consolidated Zhou rule with Duke of Zhou's assistance

notableEmperors.name: King Ping
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Moved capital east, began Eastern Zhou period

name: Qin Dynasty
description: The Qin Dynasty was the first unified imperial dynasty of China. Though short-lived, it established many systems that influenced Chinese governance for centuries.
chineseDescription: 秦朝是中国第一个统一的封建王朝。虽然短暂，但建立了影响中国数千年的制度。
achievements: Unified China for the first time

notableEmperors.name: Qin Shi Huang
notableEmperors.accomplishments: First Emperor of unified China, built the Great Wall, standardized systems

notableEmperors.name: Qin Er Shi
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Second and last emperor, reign marked by rebellion and dynasty collapse

name: Han Dynasty
description: The Han Dynasty was one of the most prosperous periods in Chinese history. It established Confucianism as state ideology and opened the Silk Road.
chineseDescription: 汉朝是中国历史上最繁荣的时期之一。确立了儒家思想的统治地位，开辟了丝绸之路。
achievements: Opened the Silk Road trade route

notableEmperors.name: Emperor Gaozu (Liu Bang)
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Founded the Han Dynasty, established stable governance

notableEmperors.name: Emperor Wen
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Benevolent rule, reduced taxes, promoted agriculture

notableEmperors.name: Emperor Jing
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Continued father's policies, strengthened central government

notableEmperors.name: Emperor Wu
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Expanded empire, opened Silk Road, promoted Confucianism

notableEmperors.name: Emperor Xuan
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Restored prosperity, balanced Confucian and Legalist policies

notableEmperors.name: Emperor Guangwu
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Founded Eastern Han, reunified China after civil war

name: Three Kingdoms Period
description: A period of division following the Han Dynasty, romanticized in Chinese culture. Three kingdoms - Wei, Shu, and Wu - competed for supremacy.
chineseDescription: 汉朝之后的分裂时期，在中国文化中被浪漫化。魏、蜀、吴三国争霸。
achievements: Foundation for Romance of the Three Kingdoms

notableEmperors.name: Cao Cao (King of Wei)
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Founded Wei, brilliant strategist and poet

notableEmperors.name: Liu Bei (Emperor of Shu)
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Founded Shu Han, known for benevolence and loyalty

notableEmperors.name: Sun Quan (Emperor of Wu)
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Founded Wu, longest-reigning of Three Kingdoms rulers

name: Jin Dynasty
description: The Jin Dynasty briefly reunified China after the Three Kingdoms period, but faced internal strife and nomadic invasions.
chineseDescription: 晋朝在三国之后短暂统一中国，但面临内乱和游牧民族入侵。

notableEmperors.name: Emperor Wu (Sima Yan)
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Founded Jin Dynasty, reunified China

notableEmperors.name: Emperor Yuan
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Founded Eastern Jin, preserved Chinese culture in south

name: Sui Dynasty
description: The Sui Dynasty reunified China after centuries of division. Though short-lived, it laid the foundation for the Tang Dynasty's prosperity.
chineseDescription: 隋朝在数百年分裂后重新统一中国。虽然短暂，但为唐朝的繁荣奠定了基础。
achievements: Reunified China after 300 years of division
Reformed the civil service examination system

notableEmperors.name: Emperor Wen (Yang Jian)
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Founded Sui Dynasty, reunified China, reformed government

notableEmperors.name: Emperor Yang
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Built Grand Canal, but excessive projects led to dynasty's fall

name: Tang Dynasty
description: The Tang Dynasty is considered a golden age of Chinese civilization, known for its cultural achievements, poetry, art, and cosmopolitan culture.
chineseDescription: 唐朝被认为是中国文明的黄金时代，以其文化成就、诗歌、艺术和国际化而闻名。
achievements: Golden age of poetry and literature

notableEmperors.name: Emperor Gaozu
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Founded Tang Dynasty, established stable rule

notableEmperors.name: Emperor Taizong
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Created prosperous era, promoted education and culture

notableEmperors.name: Empress Wu Zetian
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Only female emperor in Chinese history, promoted Buddhism

notableEmperors.name: Emperor Xuanzong
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Presided over peak of Tang prosperity and culture

notableEmperors.name: Emperor Xianzong
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Restored central authority, suppressed regional warlords

name: Song Dynasty
description: The Song Dynasty was marked by economic prosperity, technological innovation, and cultural refinement, despite military challenges.
chineseDescription: 宋朝以经济繁荣、技术创新和文化精致著称，尽管面临军事挑战。

notableEmperors.name: Emperor Taizu
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Founded Song Dynasty, reunified much of China

notableEmperors.name: Emperor Taizong
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Continued unification, promoted civil service examinations

notableEmperors.name: Emperor Zhenzong
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Maintained peace, promoted Confucian scholarship

notableEmperors.name: Emperor Renzong
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Longest reign of Song, cultural golden age

notableEmperors.name: Emperor Huizong
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Great artist and calligrapher, but weak ruler

notableEmperors.name: Emperor Gaozong
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Founded Southern Song, moved capital to Hangzhou

name: Yuan Dynasty
description: The Yuan Dynasty was established by the Mongols under Kublai Khan. It was the first time all of China was ruled by a foreign power.
chineseDescription: 元朝由蒙古人忽必烈建立，是中国首次完全被外族统治。
achievements: Promoted cultural exchange along Silk Road

notableEmperors.name: Kublai Khan
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Founded Yuan Dynasty, completed Mongol conquest of China

notableEmperors.name: Temür Khan
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Maintained stability, promoted Confucian values

notableEmperors.name: Toghon Temür
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Last Yuan emperor, lost control to Ming rebellion

name: Ming Dynasty
description: The Ming Dynasty restored Han Chinese rule and is famous for its cultural achievements, including the Forbidden City and porcelain production.
chineseDescription: 明朝恢复了汉族统治，以其文化成就著称，包括紫禁城和瓷器生产。

notableEmperors.name: Hongwu Emperor
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Founded Ming Dynasty, expelled Mongols, reformed government

notableEmperors.name: Yongle Emperor
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Built Forbidden City, sponsored Zheng He's voyages, compiled Yongle Encyclopedia

notableEmperors.name: Hongxi Emperor
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Brief but benevolent reign, reduced taxes

notableEmperors.name: Xuande Emperor
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Prosperous reign, patron of arts, skilled painter

notableEmperors.name: Jiajing Emperor
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Long reign, focused on Taoism, neglected governance

notableEmperors.name: Wanli Emperor
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Longest Ming reign, early prosperity then decline

notableEmperors.name: Chongzhen Emperor
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Last Ming emperor, committed suicide when Beijing fell

name: Qing Dynasty
description: The Qing Dynasty was China's last imperial dynasty, established by the Manchus. It saw territorial expansion but also faced Western imperialism.
chineseDescription: 清朝是中国最后一个封建王朝，由满族建立。领土扩张但也面临西方帝国主义。
achievements: Expanded Chinese territory to largest extent
Cultural synthesis of Manchu and Han traditions

notableEmperors.name: Shunzhi Emperor
notableEmperors.accomplishments: First Qing emperor in Beijing, consolidated Manchu rule

notableEmperors.name: Kangxi Emperor
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Longest-reigning emperor, expanded territory, promoted learning

notableEmperors.name: Yongzheng Emperor
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Reformed administration, strengthened central control

notableEmperors.name: Qianlong Emperor
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Presided over peak of Qing prosperity, patron of arts

notableEmperors.name: Jiaqing Emperor
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Faced internal rebellions, beginning of Qing decline

notableEmperors.name: Daoguang Emperor
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Faced Opium Wars, lost Hong Kong to Britain

notableEmperors.name: Xianfeng Emperor
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Faced Taiping Rebellion and Second Opium War

notableEmperors.name: Tongzhi Emperor
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Child emperor, Empress Dowager Cixi held real power

notableEmperors.name: Guangxu Emperor
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Attempted reforms, controlled by Empress Dowager Cixi

notableEmperors.name: Puyi (Xuantong Emperor)
notableEmperors.accomplishments: Last emperor of China, abdicated at age 6, later puppet emperor of Manchukuo
